summary: Reproduced at 2591348cf879. In the mid-rotation state (ckpt_old and ckpt_new each holding a complete job.json and state.safetensors, no ckpt), resuming with -w <work> -resume recreated an empty ckpt directory and raised FileNotFoundError for work/ckpt/job.json (load_dict, exllamav3/conversion/convert_model.py:44); neither ckpt_new nor ckpt_old was used.
what_ran: repro.py converts a tiny random 4-layer LlamaForCausalLM (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct tokenizer files) with the repository's convert_model parser/prepare/main on physical GPU 1, checkpointing after every module up to index 3, renames work/ckpt to work/ckpt_new, then runs parser/prepare/main again with -w <work> -resume. Environment py312-superset-torch26cu126.
limits: The interruption is simulated by producing its directory state from a finished run; a process killed between the two renames was not tested. Attempts 001/002 were environment and argument errors.
modifications: Fixture state only: after a real checkpointed conversion, work/ckpt is renamed to work/ckpt_new to produce the mid-rotation directory state. Upstream is not modified.
